page.layout: One column of text, with a printed ornament (fleuron) between the second paragraph and the catchword; no margin notes. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: PHILIPPVS LABBÆVS S. I. Presbyter.
In Cenotaphio Ioannæ Papissæ. p. 838.

p.i: Leonem Allatium Chium, qui ex monu-mentis Græcis confutationem fabulæ illius edidit Romæ Anno 1630. quam recudendam curauit Coloniæ anno 1645. Bartoldus Nihu-sius, adiunctis Prologo, Epilogo, & Te-lescopio.

main_text.p: Pag. 913. Quorum annis si adjicias Ioannæ Papissæ duos annos, menses quinque & dies quatuor non anni 45. sed 47. numerandi fuerant, ut ait Leo Allatius, qui etiam aduertit a primo Leonis anno, &c.

page.notes: The "ɞ"-like mark at the top right corner is not printed text and is left out. The ornament below the text is a printer's fleuron, not transcribed. The first paragraph and the "Quorum" paragraph appear to be in italic type; the italic boundaries are read from the scan and may be slightly off. Printed "Chium ," and "Pag. 913." spacing is normalised. The printed "vt" and "aduertit" are corrected to "ut" and "aduertit" per the u/v rule.
